title: Case Study of the Use of Biometrics in Impact Network Schools in Rural Zambia
why_not: An NGO's own pilot: Impact Network and Simprints recorded daily fingerprint attendance in eight of Impact Network's rural primary schools from 2017 to 2020, on CommCare, read by the two partners and not the ministry; teachers kept the manual register as well. Attendance only and nothing sent to the ministry, so noted, not assessed.
